svg.title: Direction of the long spike through rotation then reflection
svg.text: Track the long spike (image coordinates, y down)
Op 1, clockwise 90 degrees about the centre: NE becomes SE
Q: spike points down-right (SE) matches the figure
Op 2, reflection in a horizontal line: SE becomes NE (up and down swap)
R: spike points up-right (NE) matches the figure
A vertical-line reflection would send SE to SW, so (C) fails.
